incident-bot: PAGER: auth-proxy high 401 spike from 45.33.21.10 -> alertID INC-2026-332. Rate ~3k/min. Severity: P2. Triggered at 2026-03-17T21:14:04Z
alice: I'm oncall, investigating. @ben can you check whether any keys were leaked? @caroline FYI for routing/fallback.
ben: Looking now. Initial impression: traffic from a cloud crawler IP range. Pattern shows token reuse across sessions, lots of 401s but no obvious successful account takeovers yet.
ben: ```
[edge-proxy] 2026-03-17T21:12:58Z src=45.33.21.10 method=POST path=/v1/generate auth=Bearer ***** token_id=svc-12345 status=401
[edge-proxy] 2026-03-17T21:13:02Z src=45.33.21.10 method=POST path=/v1/generate auth=Bearer ***** token_id=svc-12345 status=401
```
caroline: svc-12345 -> that's a staging service token bound to ci-runner. Should not be hitting prod edge. Ben, can you confirm the token_id mapping? If it's a staging token leaked into a public harness we need a scoped rotation.
ben: Token_id maps to staging-runner@project-x. Creation event: 2026-03-15T03:00Z via CI job (jenkins-prod). Looks like creds got copied to a public test harness. No customer tokens observed so far.
dave: I'll kick off a scoped rotation for svc-12345 and revoke active sessions. Running: `redwood secrets rotate svc-12345 --scope=edge --preserve-latest`
dave: ```
> redwood secrets rotate svc-12345 --scope=edge --preserve-latest
Rotating key: svc-12345 -> svc-12345.v2
Revoking active sessions for svc-12345
OK  (completed 21s)
```
alice: :+1: Thanks. Ben, confirm customers unaffected? Quick customer-impact summary: none reported, some background jobs hit 401 and retried which caused transient spikes.
ben: Confirmed: zero customer API keys tied to svc-12345. Affected workload limited to internal staging CI. I've flagged the CI job owner to purge credentials and rotate their runner token. Opening an infra audit ticket now.
legal: Preserve all raw logs and maintain chain-of-custody. Tag incident INC-2026-332 and retain logs for 90 days. Notify legal if any customer identifiers appear in logs.
caroline: I'll take monitoring for the next hour. Setting alert: auto-close when 401 rate returns to baseline for 30m. Also validating that fallback routing behaved as expected.
alice: Handoff -> caroline. Summary: staging token leaked to public test harness -> automated attempts from third-party IP -> rotated & revoked, no customer keys affected, logs preserved. Next actions: CI job credential rotation + PR to prevent plaintext creds in artifacts.
eve: I'm on standby as next-oncall. Will verify CI job rotation and confirm in ~30m.
ben: Ticket INF-4521 created, assigned to sam-ci. Following up with owner. Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring.
incident-bot: INC-2026-332 update: status=mitigated, updated_by=alice, time=2026-03-17T21:25:44Z
